name: Smart NFC Tools: Read & Write
dev: Arthur Eduardo Skaetta Alvarez Desenvolvimento de Software LTDA.

ios.desc:
Smart NFC Tools is the most accessible and easy to use NFC Reader and Writer for mobile devices! With a simple user interface and powerful tools you can interact with NDEF-Formatted NFC cards without any external hardware!

- Read, Inspect and modify:
Read a tag by touching the back of your device against it and Smart NFC Tools will show you a full report on the tag's content and give you options such as erase, lock and copy. It's super easy!

- Write in many formats:
Smart NFC Tools enables you to write NFC tags in popular formats that allow for custom interactions such as opening a website or triggering a phone call just by touching the tag with a compatible device!

- Note about privacy:
Smart NFC Tools works 100% offline, without any personal or content data being sent to an external server or third party server. Your privacy is our priority!

Embrace the world of NFC technologies using your phone or tablet! Smart NFC Tools is now available for all iOS devices!

quotes.text:
This is not my experience. I purchased blank NFC cards and made myself this guide to get them working just fine:

1. Use NXP TagWriter to format card to NDEF format. 
2. Use Smart NFC tools app to copy from existing MyYo card to new one.
3. Using the Yoto app, Play the playlist on the target Yoto. This will trigger the tracks to download onto the YoTo.
4. Make sure all tracks are downloaded onto Yoto before inserting new card.

Smart NFC tools: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/smart-nfc-tools-read-write/id1527587931

NXP Tag writer: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/nfc-tagwriter-by-nxp/id1246143221

After a few years now with two kids using Yoto, however, I think it is a little overkill to go this route and the reduced friction of using Yoto’s own cards makes it worth it, despite the cost. But this may help others who use them differently than we do!
